name: Noyama Kaede
source:
She is the third daughter of the Noyama family, who is very caring and has a lot of energy.
She has a lively personality and is popular among her peers. She is the type of person who always starts talking before thinking. She is sensitive to smells and notices even the slightest change on Ringo. She is interested in sex, but is too shy to speak with anyone about it, so her knowledge of sex is quite limited.
